---
title: "Spoiler: Solutions"
---

Extract scaffold 1
```{.bash}
vcftools --vcf /proj/mykopat-popgen-c/course_files/2_source_data/part2_vcf_manipulation/Phenig_final_0619.recode.vcf --chr scaffold_1 --recode --recode-INFO-all --out scaffold1
```
Remove indels
```{.bash}
vcftools --vcf scaffold_1.recode.vcf --remove-indels --recode --out scaffold_1_noindels
```
Keep biallelic sites only
```{.bash}
vcftools --vcf scaffold_1_noindels.recode.vcf --min-alleles 2 --max-alleles 2 --recode --out scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic 
```
Depth
```{.bash}
vcftools --vcf scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic.recode.vcf --depth --out scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic
```
Site depth
```{.bash}
vcftools --vcf scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic.recode.vcf --site-depth --out scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic 
```
Site mean depth
```{.bash}
vcftools --vcf scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic.recode.vcf --site-mean-depth --out scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic 
```
Tajima's D
```{.bash}
vcftools --vcf scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic.recode.vcf --TajimaD 5000 --out scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic.tajd5000
```
Pi per site
```{.bash}
vcftools --vcf scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic.recode.vcf --site-pi --out scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic
```
Pi in windows
```{.bash}
vcftools --vcf scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic.recode.vcf --window-pi 5000 --out scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic.pi5000
```
Keeping only certain individuals from populations
```{.bash}
vcftools --vcf scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic.recode.vcf --keep pop_to_keep --recode --out scaffold_1_pop
```
Rerun Tajima's D on these VCFs/populations you have chosen. Of course, you can use the keep flag on the complete VCF without writing to a new VCF, saving some space.

FST
```{.bash}
vcftools-haploid --vcf scaffold_1_noindels_biallelic.recode.vcf --weir-fst-pop pop1 --weir-fst-pop pop2 --fst-window-size --out fst_pop1_vs_pop2
```

## Plotting in R
Here I just show you an example from the idepth file. You can remove lines not relevant for your populations. I just plotted across the entire dataset

```{.r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

#Plotting .idepth file 
idepth = read.delim("wherever_your_file_is", header = T)

names(idepth)[names(idepth) == 'INDV'] <- 'ID'

idepth = idepth %>%
  mutate(Population = case_when(
    startsWith(ID, "BIL") ~ "bil",
    startsWith(ID, "BNP") ~ "bnp",
    startsWith(ID, "Her") ~ "her",
    startsWith(ID, "Iss") ~ "iss",
    startsWith(ID, "Kai") ~ "kai",
    startsWith(ID, "Koi") ~ "koi",
    startsWith(ID, "Kot") ~ "kot",
    startsWith(ID, "Luu") ~ "luu",
    startsWith(ID, "Met") ~ "met",
    startsWith(ID, "Mor") ~ "mor",
    startsWith(ID, "Mus") ~ "mus",
    startsWith(ID, "Myl") ~ "myl",
    startsWith(ID, "Pam") ~ "pam",
    startsWith(ID, "Pat") ~ "pat",
    startsWith(ID, "Pet") ~ "pet",
    startsWith(ID, "Puk") ~ "puk",
    startsWith(ID, "Rus") ~ "rus",
    startsWith(ID, "Sig") ~ "sig",
    startsWith(ID, "Skj") ~ "skj",
    startsWith(ID, "eSK") ~ "skj",
    startsWith(ID, "Spk") ~ "spk",
    startsWith(ID, "Sus") ~ "sus",
    startsWith(ID, "Ulv") ~ "ulv",
    startsWith(ID, "Van") ~ "van",
    startsWith(ID, "Ves") ~ "ves"))
    
idepth = idepth %>%
      mutate(Location = case_when(
        startsWith(ID, "BIL") ~ "Sweden",
        startsWith(ID, "BNP") ~ "Poland",
        startsWith(ID, "Her") ~ "SWF",
        startsWith(ID, "Iss") ~ "NEF",
        startsWith(ID, "Kai") ~ "NEF",
        startsWith(ID, "Koi") ~ "NEF",
        startsWith(ID, "Kot") ~ "SWF",
        startsWith(ID, "Luu") ~ "SWF",
        startsWith(ID, "Met") ~ "SWF",
        startsWith(ID, "Mor") ~ "Norway",
        startsWith(ID, "Mus") ~ "SWF",
        startsWith(ID, "Myl") ~ "SWF",
        startsWith(ID, "Pam") ~ "NEF",
        startsWith(ID, "Pat") ~ "NEF",
        startsWith(ID, "Pet") ~ "SWF",
        startsWith(ID, "Puk") ~ "SWF",
        startsWith(ID, "Rus") ~ "Russia",
        startsWith(ID, "Sig") ~ "Norway",
        startsWith(ID, "Skj") ~ "Norway",
        startsWith(ID, "eSK") ~ "Norway",
        startsWith(ID, "Spk") ~ "Norway",
        startsWith(ID, "Sus") ~ "SWF",
        startsWith(ID, "Ulv") ~ "NEF",
        startsWith(ID, "Van") ~ "NEF",
        startsWith(ID, "Ves") ~ "SWF"
      ))

#try with and without face_wrap
ggplot(idepth, aes(x=ID, y =MEAN_DEPTH, fill=Population)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~Location, scales = "free_x")
```

## Plotting Tajima's D all vs specific populations
You can change the type of plots you make. Change headers, xlab, and ylab

```{.r}
#Plotting Tajima's D
taj.combined = read.delim("teaching/forest_popgen/all.tajd5000.Tajima.D", header = T)
taj.bil = read.delim("teaching/forest_popgen/bil.tajd5000.Tajima.D", header = T)

#Mutating the add a column for population
taj.combined = mutate(taj.combined, Population = "All")
taj.bil = mutate(taj.bil, Population = "BIL")

#combining the dataframes
combining.tajd = c('taj.combined', 'taj.bil')
x.list = lapply(combining.tajd, get)
combined.tajd = do.call(rbind, x.list)

#Plotting combined Tajima's D
ggplot(combined.tajd, aes(x= BIN_START, y = TajimaD, col=Population)) +
  geom_line() 
  ```
